violations.text: Corn and Nacho Cheese were observed held at 115 and 101 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were reheated to 170 degrees Fahrenheit during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

Prep unit in front area was observed at 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Cut watermelon was observed at 45 degrees Fahrenheit and was voluntarily disposed of. All other ingredients were non TCS foods. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. No foods that require refrigeration for food safety to be placed into unit until properly adjusted and can maintain an internal food temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026
Hand sink in back prep area was observed detached from discharge pipe during time of inspection. Equipment to be in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026
3 bay sink was observed leaking from discharge pipe. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2025
